posts.title: October Weekends at Jubilee Harvest Festival
posts.headline: Bellevue · 星期日亲子精选
posts.bannerText: 一起发现身边的小惊喜！
highlights: 🌿 可以体验户外与运动主题活动。💛 适合安排周末亲子时光。
posts.description: This might be our favorite season of the whole year. Come celebrate with our whole community! Our neighbors bring their ponies, local artists come to share their talents, our friends in a jug-band play tunes on the porch…it takes a village. Grab a hot spiced cider at the barn (maybe help press a few apples to make more cider?), visit the animals, and take a hay ride out to the pumpkin patch. FIND YOUR PUMPKINS There are pumpkins of all shapes, sizes, & colors out in the field! After you find your pumpkins & gourds and bring them back to the barn, we have a pumpkin-washing station, so you can get all the farm-fresh mud cleaned off them. TRACTOR RIDES (free) Hop on a wagon and let a tractor take you out to the pumpkin patch! HORSE-DRAWN CARRIAGE (free) Let a team of draft horses take you to the pumpkin patch! (Horse team is weather-dependent and often retires around 3 pm) HAY MAZE Visit the old cattle loafing shed (behind the white barn) to find a sweet hay maze…the perfect size for littles. PONY RIDES Our neighbors from Fall City Pony & Horse Farm (aka Party Ponies) bring their ponies out every weekend in October (as long as it’s not too soggy!) They charge $9 per ride. Image sourced from event website.

posts.title: Storywalk at Alderwood Park: César’s Cerulean Surprise
posts.headline: Tacoma · 星期六亲子精选
highlights: 📚 可以体验教育与探索主题活动。💛 适合安排周末亲子时光。
posts.description: Walk along and read the Storywalk at Alderwood Park during the park’s open hours. The September/October title is César’s Cerulean Surprise by Jenny Lacika. César asks to borrow his sister Gabi’s cerulean crayon, but Gabi does not know what cerulean is and decides to identify the color by asking yes-no questions. It’s a window into an all-too-familiar sibling dynamic, a slice of life many readers can identify with. Along with the subtle math hints, both Gabi and César sprinkle in Spanish words. Further explanation can be found in an author’s note, along with interactive tips for adults, showing how to encourage the math connections during reading.

posts.description: Welcome to Fun Park @ Thomas Family Farm. Open every Saturday and Sunday 10am-6pm in October. Fun Park will keep everyone entertained, big and little alike. Sports toss, tire climb, duck races, playground and more! A Fall Family Farm event wouldn’t be complete without a Pumpkin Patch & Corn Maze. We have 149 different varieties of pumpkins with over 140,000 to choose from! We have modified our corn maze to meet COVID policies. We increased path sizes to 8ft wide and decreased the distance to 2.1 miles. There is a halfway point where you can leave early once you reach that point. It will be muddy, wear sturdy footwear.

highlights: 🌿 可以体验户外与运动主题活动。💛 适合安排周末亲子时光。
posts.description: Named Washington State’s best pumpkin patch by “Readers Digest” in 2019, and more recently among the best pumpkin farms in the country (!), this farm is justifiably very popular, especially with younger kids. As the Snohomish Valley’s Original Pumpkin Patch, Craven Farm is a decades old tradition for many families. Continue your family tradition or start a new one this fall at Craven Farm! At Craven Farm, we’re dedicated to creating an enjoyable and memorable fall experience for everyone who visits us. Our farm offers an extensive range of activities to suit all age groups, including apple cannons and slingers, fair foods, espresso, and donuts. Our unique attractions like cow trains, wagon rides, multiple acres of themed corn mazes, jump pad & animals are sure to keep you entertained for hours on end. Visit us today and make some unforgettable memories with us this fall! Check out our huge list of pumpkin extravaganzas happening this year.

highlights: 挑战动物解剖拼图，做只小蝙蝠带回家，并在毛绒玩具上练习动物准备技能。近距离遇见远古猛兽，揭开会发光的矿物与华盛顿洞穴的地质秘密。
